rules.name: User temporary files
rules.description: Keep files created or modified in the last seven days.

rules.name: Windows temporary files
rules.description: Only the Temp directory; inaccessible files are skipped without changing permissions.

rules.name: DirectX and NVIDIA shader cache
rules.description: Games may compile shaders again after cleanup.

rules.name: Old crash dumps
rules.description: Deleting dumps removes the corresponding diagnostic evidence.

rules.name: Windows error reports
rules.description: Only archived and queued error reports; inaccessible files are skipped.
